mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/package-comparison.test.ts:archive comparison separates equivalent XML, changed binary, additions and removals without requiring an OPC graph
outcomes: Graph-free archives classify a.xml as equivalent XML, b.bin as changed, c.bin as added and removed.bin as removed, with empty unchanged and exact caller-buffer custody.
gaps: Native input adds a removed member unlike the shared no-removal case. There is no OPC graph requirement or Office document interpretation; categories concern admitted member payloads, not rendered semantics.
Bounded source mapping: no new execution, general semantic completeness or canonical-XML credit. Direct/deferred assertions and loop review flags retained; runtime leaves unknown.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/package-comparison.test.ts:each archive passes ZIP integrity and independent resource budgets before classification

gaps: Native finite admission/budget matrix, not a measurement of timing/allocation or a proof of every limit independently. CRC corruption is tested on the second archive only; no caller-buffer comparison here.
